triage_method: manual batch triage by the audit-routine model: keyword shortlist (מחקר/דוח/סקר/נתונים/אחוז/מדגם/חשיפה/נחשף/numerals etc.) over all 447 candidate headlines, narrowed to 49 keyword hits, then individually read and classified against the spec's detect exclusions and scope rule.
environment_note: WebFetch is EGRESS_BLOCKED for this session for outlet domains (ynet.co.il confirmed blocked on a live test) as in the precedent run; WebSearch (Anthropic-hosted) works. Article bodies were not fetched directly; body_ok=0 expected for all outlets unless an audit subagent finds an allow-listed mirror. Claims are reconstructed from headlines plus WebSearch snippets per story body_fetch_notes, consistent with the 2026-09-27 precedent.
